title: PAC-style Bounds on the Conditional Validity of Conformal Predictors
abstract: arXiv:2611.33023v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Conformal prediction sets are guaranteed to be marginally valid over the attribute space, but local coverage can diverge from the user-defined target $1-\alpha$. Constructing conditionally valid prediction sets with finite calibration data is impossible for a general data-generating distribution. We derive PAC-type probabilistic lower bounds on the input-conditional coverage of any conformal predictor, without assumptions on the data distribution. They are based on the Markov and Cantelli inequalities and adapt to both calibration-marginal and calibration-conditional setups. A tighter, model-dependent Cantelli bound depends on the variance of the conditional coverage and is estimable from data using a fully non-asymptotic Hoeffding argument. The results suggest conditional-coverage variance as a scalable and theoretically motivated empirical measure of conditional validity.

translated_title: 共形预测器条件有效性的PAC式界
translated_abstract: 共形预测集在属性空间上保证具有边际有效性，但局部覆盖率可能偏离用户定义的目标 $1-\alpha$。对于一般的数据生成分布，使用有限的校准数据构造条件有效的预测集是不可能的。我们在不对数据分布做任何假设的情况下，推导出任意共形预测器的输入条件覆盖率的PAC型概率下界。这些下界基于马尔可夫不等式和坎泰利（Cantelli）不等式，并同时适用于校准边际和校准条件两种设置。一个更紧的、依赖于模型的坎泰利界取决于条件覆盖率的方差，并且可以通过完全非渐近的Hoeffding论证从数据中进行估计。这些结果表明，条件覆盖率方差可以作为条件有效性的一种可扩展且有理论依据的经验度量。
tldr: 本文在不假设数据分布的前提下，基于马尔可夫和坎泰利不等式为任意共形预测器的条件覆盖率推导出PAC型概率下界，并提出将条件覆盖率方差作为条件有效性的一种可扩展且有理论支撑的经验度量。
en_tdlr: This paper derives distribution-free PAC-type probabilistic lower bounds on the conditional coverage of any conformal predictor using Markov and Cantelli inequalities, and proposes conditional-coverage variance as a scalable, theoretically motivated empirical measure of conditional validity.
